description: This script generates an Xbox One (xb1) package from loose files, including creating appx packages, signing them, and handling splash screens and appx data. It defines a Package class for building and packaging UWP appx files, with methods for copying files, updating manifests, and building the package using Windows SDK tools.

classes.name: Package
classes.description: Represents an installable UWP Appx package for Xbox One, with methods to build, sign, and prepare the package.

methods.name: AddArguments
methods.description: Adds xb1-specific command-line arguments to the parser.

methods.name: ExtractArguments
methods.description: Extracts relevant arguments for package creation.

methods.name: _GetDestinationSplashScreenDir
methods.description: Returns the directory for the splash screen in the package.

methods.name: _CleanSplashScreenDir
methods.description: Removes existing splash screen directory if it exists.

methods.name: _CopySplashScreen
methods.description: Copies the appropriate splash screen file into the package content.

methods.name: _CopyAppxData
methods.description: Copies appx data content from source to package directory.

methods.name: _UpdateAppxManifestPublisher
methods.description: Updates the Publisher attribute in the Appx manifest XML.

methods.name: _BuildPackage
methods.description: Builds the appx package using Windows SDK tools and signs it.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Placeholder for package installation method (not implemented).

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments and initiate package creation.
